name: app-decoding-full-epochs
summary: Decodes conditions from MEG gradiometer epochs with a logistic-regression classifier in MNE-Python and plots the 5-fold cross-validated ROC AUC scores.
description: Selects the 'auditory' epochs and gradiometer channels, then runs a Scaler-Vectorizer-LogisticRegression pipeline with mne.decoding.cross_val_multiscore (5 splits, ROC AUC) to classify the event codes, and saves a box plot of the scores. The condition name is hard-coded, so it only works for epochs with an 'auditory' condition (as in the MNE sample dataset); it looks like a demonstration App.

inputs.requirements: Must contain an 'auditory' event condition and gradiometer channels.

outputs.description: Box plot (PNG) of cross-validation ROC AUC scores.
